source: Who's On First (whosonfirst-data-admin-us latest dist, downloaded 2026-10-31): placetype neighbourhood (Zetashapes, Quattroshapes) plus placetype locality (Wake County's towns: Cary, Apex, Garner, Wake Forest and others, and Durham County's: Durham, Gorman, Rougemont (D-601; WOF's Durham neighbourhoods are points only), Quattroshapes; the City of Raleigh itself left out) as the coarser fallback, the smallest outline winning; current, polygon geometries whose label point is inside Wake or Durham County (config/metro-bounds/raleigh.json); none from OpenStreetMap; WOF's bare "East" left out; simplified to ~20 m, coordinates to 4 decimals (D-600).
